title: Multi-stream QKV Mirror roles
hypothesis: Four parallel streams can use stream-conditioned views over shared QKV projections with lower serialized bytes than independent per-stream QKV matrices while matching causal attention outputs. Mirror-specific value requires beating native shared-basis stream coefficients; no future-token or cross-stream leakage may occur.

task.metric: causal attention output NRMSE, serialized bytes, projection/attention MAC proxy, future leakage and cross-stream leakage

development.selection_metric: quality/bytes/causal-integrity; exact native alias seals fresh

controls: Mirror shared QKV base plus rank-1 shared QKV atom and stream code
Native shared-basis rank-1 stream coefficient control

storage.authority: Actual serialized complete inference payload bytes

compute: causal attention QK and PV MACs
success_gate: Mirror output NRMSE <=0.02, complete payload <=60% of independent QKV, future and cross-stream leakage <=1e-6. Mirror-specific success additionally requires strict Pareto gain over native shared-basis coefficients.
failure_gate: Quality/causal/storage gate miss or exact native control alias without strict function-level gain; fresh stays sealed after exact alias.
boundaries: Synthetic single-head causal attention screen only; not a trained Multi-Stream LLM
Each stream has independent causal attention and no cross-stream attention by construction; perturbation tests validate this isolation
Future-token perturbation must leave all earlier outputs invariant
All QKV tensors and mask metadata are charged in NPZ payload
No language quality, training, throughput or capacity claim
